izzyondroid:com.aicodix.rattlegram.name: Rattlegram - SMS via audio!
izzyondroid:com.aicodix.rattlegram.summary: Transmit short text messages over COFDMTV encoded audio signals
izzyondroid:com.aicodix.rattlegram.description:
Rattlegram lets you transmit short text messages over COFDMTV encoded audio signals. COFDMTV is based on COFDM (coded orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing) technology:
 160 ms long OFDM symbols
 6.25 Hz per sub-carrier
 1/8 guard interval
 differentially encoded PSK (phase-shift keying) modulation
 systematic polar codes for forward error correction
 Currently Modes 14, 15 and 16 are supported: Using either SPC(2048, 1392), SPC(2048, 1056) or SPC(2048, 712) with CRC32C aided SCL decoding and differential QPSK modulation for the payload. Only a bandwidth of 1600 Hz is needed and the transmission of either 85, 128 or 170 bytes take about one second with the leading noise and fancy header disabled.

izzyondroid:me.arianb.usb_hid_client.name: USB HID Client
izzyondroid:me.arianb.usb_hid_client.summary: use your phone as a keyboard and mouse WITHOUT any software on the other end
izzyondroid:me.arianb.usb_hid_client.description:
This Android app allows you your phone to present itself to a connected device as a keyboard and mouse. Since this happens at a very low level, the connected device sees it exactly as a normal keyboard and mouse, meaning you don't need to install any software on the connected computer! For this reason, it will even work if the connected device is in its BIOS/UEFI. Even multimedia keys are supported, meaning you can send volume up/down keys to the connected computer to control media. I strongly recommend using Unexpected Keyboard to use special keys such as modifier and function keys , but most functionality will work with any standard Android keyboard.
 Bonus description for nerds: This app adds (and provides a simple UI for you to communicate with) two character devices ( /dev/hidg0 and /dev/hidg1 respectively) by adding HID functions to the default Android USB gadget. If you wanted to, you could just use this app to create the character devices, then communicate solely through some C program, shell script, or whatever else you wanted as long as it had the right permissions to access the character devices and knew how to send proper reports to them. Beware of SELinux policies if you do that though. If anyone is actually doing that, let me know, I'd be glad to help if necessary.
 For more details on setup and usage, please consult the project's Readme.

fdroid:com.github.cvzi.screenshottile.name: Screenshot Tile (NoRoot)
fdroid:com.github.cvzi.screenshottile.summary: Customizable screenshot tool with quick settings shortcut and floating button
fdroid:com.github.cvzi.screenshottile.description:
Adds a button/tile to the quick settings panel to take screenshots.
After install you need to add the button/tile to your quick settings and then grant the permissions to record screen captures and save images to the internal storage.
 Features:
✓ Take screenshots from the quick settings
✓ No root required
✓ Notification after a screenshot was taken (can be disabled)
✓ Immediately share, edit or delete a screenshot from the notification
✓ Edit the screenshot with the included image editor
✓ Floating button/Overlay button like a chat bubble (Android 9+)
✓ Use as assist app to take a screenshot (long-press the Home button)
✓ Only take screenshot of a specific area of the screen (long-press the tile)
✓ Delay taking a screenshot
✓ Store in any folder on any storage e.g. sd card
✓ Store in different file formats: png, jpg or webp
✓ Take automatic screenshots with apps like Tasker or MacroDroid
✓ Free, open-source, no advertising
This is a fork of "Screenshot Tile [Root]" but it does not require root.
Source code: github.com/cvzi/ScreenshotTile 
Original app: github.com/ipcjs/ScreenshotTile 
Open Source license is GNU GPLv3
 Note: 
🎦 When you take a screenshot, the "Google Cast" icon will appear in the status bar and it will be visible in the screenshot image.
If you want to hide the icon, there is an explanation here: github.com/cvzi/ScreenshotTile#icon 
 Permissions:
❏ android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE "Photos/Media/Files and Storage" 
This is required to save the screenshot files on the internal storage of your device.
❏ android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE 
Since Android 9/Pie this permission is required to take screenshots. It basically means that this app can run without showing itself. However the app will always show a notification when it is running.
 Automatic screenshots:
If you want to automate screenshots from another app, e.g. MacroDroid or Tasker, you can find a step-by-step guide here:
 github.com/cvzi/ScreenshotTile#automatic-screenshots-with-broadcast-intents 
 Hiding the app icon:
In the app settings you can hide the app icon from your launcher. You can still access the app by long pressing the tile in your quick settings. Unfortunately, Android 10 does not allow hiding an app anymore.
 🌎 Support and translations
If there is a problem or you want to help translate this app into your language, please contact me on github.com/cvzi/ScreenshotTile/issues , cuzi-android@openmail.cc or contribute a translation on https://crowdin.com/project/screenshottile/ 
This app can access the Accessibility Services API which allows this app to record the screen. Data is neither collected nor shared by this app using the accessibility capabilities.

fdroid:de.schliweb.sambalite.name: SambaLite
fdroid:de.schliweb.sambalite.summary: A lightweight, modern, and open-source Android client for SMB/CIFS shares.
fdroid:de.schliweb.sambalite.description:
SambaLite is a lightweight, modern, and open-source Android client for SMB/CIFS shares (Samba).
It is designed as a minimalist, reliable, and secure tool for accessing SMB shares on your local network – without ads, tracking, or unnecessary features.
SambaLite is a file client, not a system-level filesystem. It focuses on accessing and transferring files, not on providing a mounted network drive.
The app is intended for tech-savvy users who prefer a lean, transparent solution and value privacy and open source.
Main features:
• Manage connections: SMB server (hostname/IP), share/path, username, password, optional domain
• Multiple connections with custom names
• Connection testing with clear error messages
• Secure credential storage (Android Keystore)
• File browser with name, type, size, and modification date
• Pull-to-refresh
• Sorting (name, date, size)
• File operations: download, upload, delete, rename
• File properties
• Dark/Light mode (system default)
Compatibility:
• Supports modern SMB2/SMB3 servers
• SMB1 is not supported (deprecated and insecure)
Security & Privacy:
• No telemetry or third-party connections
• No unencrypted storage of sensitive data
• Credentials stored securely using the Android Keystore
Permissions:
SambaLite only requests the permissions required for its functionality:
• Network access (SMB communication)
• Access to user-selected storage locations (via Android system file picker)
• Foreground service and notifications (for reliable background transfers and progress display)
No data is collected or transmitted to third parties.
SambaLite provides a modern, minimal, and privacy-friendly way to access SMB shares on Android – focused on reliability and transparency.

fdroid:info.dvkr.screenstream.name: ScreenStream
fdroid:info.dvkr.screenstream.description:
The application allows viewing the device screen in your web browser. The main
idea is to show your device screen during presentations and demos. No need of
any additional software except for this app and a web browser. No annoying ads
or pop-ups.
It uses MJPEG to encode screen images and send them through the network. So it
works with any desktop or mobile browser which supports MJPEG (Chrome, Safari,
EDGE, Firefox).
The application works via WiFi and/or 3G/LTE network. Fast and stable WiFi
recommended because of high traffic and low network delay requirement. No
Internet required, however, there must be a network connection between the
client and the device.
The number of client connections is unlimited, but be aware that each of them
requires some CPU resources and bandwidth to send data.
Application uses Android Cast feature and requires at least Android 5.0 to run.
WARNING: This is not a real time streaming app. Expected delay is at least 0.5-1
second or more on slow devices, bad WiFi or on heavy CPU load by other apps.
WARNING: This app is not designed for streaming video, especially HD video. Use
Chromecast instead.
WARNING: This app does NOT support SOUND streaming, because MJPEG does not
support sound.
WARNING: Some cell operators may block incoming connections to your device for
security reasons, so, even if the device has an IP address from a cell operator,
you may not be able to connect to the device on using this IP address.
WARNING: Some WiFi networks (mostly public/guest) block connections between its
clients for security reasons, so you may not be able to connect to the device
via WiFi. For example, a laptop and a phone in this such a WiFi network will not
be able to connect to each other.

fdroid:io.github.melastore.shelf.name: Shelf
fdroid:io.github.melastore.shelf.summary: Hide folders instantly behind a working decoy app. Root optional.
fdroid:io.github.melastore.shelf.description:
Shelf is a private-space utility that can appear on the launcher as a habit
tracker, calendar, or calculator. Each decoy is a functional app with its own
name, icon, and colour scheme.
Five taps in the top-right corner open the credential prompt. Settings adds a
second, quieter gesture: a long or double tap on the decoy title, or the PIN
typed straight into the calculator. Access uses a PIN, a password, a 3×3 pattern, or a
knock code on four unmarked quarters. The knock pad shows a blank screen while
it is entered, so a watcher learns neither the length of the code nor how far
through it you are. Optional strong-biometric unlock always opens the real
space, with the credential as fallback. The entry gesture can also put up a
fake app-has-stopped dialog; a long press on its message carries on to the
credential.
Auto hide runs after screen off, immediately when Shelf leaves the foreground,
or never. It closes the private space and puts exposed folders back out of
sight. A timer can also put them back after a set time with the screen on. An optional quiet notification, under the disguise's own name, offers
the same emergency hide on demand.
Folders you add stay on the list whether or not they are hidden, and one control
hides or unhides all of them at once. A hidden folder can be opened without
unhiding it: photos, video, audio, PDFs, and text are decrypted as they are
read, with nothing written back to disk and no gallery picking them up.
An optional second credential opens a private space that looks and behaves like
the real one and contains nothing that matters, the one to give up if you are
ever made to hand one over. Shelf records that it was used and tells you on your
next real unlock, along with any wrong credentials someone else tried.
A separate emergency PIN wipes Shelf's records and credentials as soon as it is
entered at any unlock prompt. Turning the phone face down or plugging in a
USB cable can also lock everything at once.
Folders can be hidden in three ways: with root, by clearing permission bits on
the backing filesystem; with optional all-files access, by moving the folder
under random names into a hidden directory; or with no special permission, by
renaming it with a leading dot through the system folder picker. All three
replace file names with opaque identifiers, protect the first 64 KiB of each
file, and keep the originals in a recovery manifest encrypted with your
credential. Folders at the top of internal storage or in Download need
all-files access, since Android grants no picker access there.
Each folder operation is journalled before anything changes. Recovery markers,
"Unhide everything", read-only health checks, and a password-encrypted export
of recovery records cover reinstalls and lost app data.
The theme follows the system or is fixed to light, dark, or AMOLED. Shelf can be
kept out of the recent apps list, and screenshots of the private space are
blocked unless you allow them.
Root is optional. Shelf has no network access, analytics, advertising, or cloud
service.
Shelf does not provide full-file encryption. Data beyond each protected header
remains recoverable with forensic tools, and historical file names may remain in
system or app caches. Shelf is designed to prevent casual browsing, not resist
an attacker with root access. The full threat model is at
https://github.com/melastore/shelf/blob/main/THREAT_MODEL.md

fdroid:io.github.ukpratik.lanternsudoku.name: Lantern Sudoku
fdroid:io.github.ukpratik.lanternsudoku.summary: Calm, readable sudoku with hints that teach. No ads, no game over, offline.
fdroid:io.github.ukpratik.lanternsudoku.description:
Lantern Sudoku is a quiet sudoku for short, calm sessions. It has no ads, no account and no game over, and it works fully offline.
When you're stuck, a hint lights the next step instead of giving the answer away. You choose how much help you want:
• Where to look: the area where the next step is.
• Why: the technique by name, with a short explanation and the cells that matter highlighted.
• The digit, only if you want it.
If a digit on the board is wrong, the hint tells you that first, so you never chase a step built on a mistake.
Honest puzzles
• Four levels: Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert.
• Every puzzle has exactly one solution and never needs guessing.
• Each puzzle is graded by the hardest technique it needs, so a level means the same thing every time.
• More than 11,000 puzzles come with the app. Nothing is downloaded.
A daily puzzle
• One puzzle a day, the same for everyone, with a streak and days played.
• Share a spoiler-free result card if you like. Nothing is shared unless you tap Share.
Made to be easy on the eyes
• Large, clear digits, with a Larger digits option.
• Light, Dark and two high-contrast themes.
• Works with large system text and with TalkBack.
Never punished
• Mistakes can be shown or hidden. A mistake limit is optional and off by default.
• Your game is saved after every move. Undo, redo, erase and notes that tidy themselves when you place a digit.
• A calm summary when you finish, and statistics per level.
Private by design
• No ads, no analytics, no crash reporting, no account.

apple-macos:6705122081.description:
Watch your own live HLS streams on Apple TV and iPhone.
HLS Streaming turns any HTTP Live Streaming (.m3u8) address into a channel you can surf like live TV. Add the streams you already use — news, events, church services, cameras, your own broadcasts — and switch between them with a swipe.
CHANNEL SURFING
• Swipe up or down on the Siri Remote, or click the top and bottom of the clickpad, to jump to the next or previous channel
• Channel Up/Down buttons on compatible remotes work too
• On iPhone, swipe up or down on the video
• A banner shows the channel number and what's next, and on Apple TV a Channels menu in the playback controls lets you jump anywhere
SUBTITLES AND CLOSED CAPTIONS
• Shows subtitles carried in the stream (WebVTT) and CEA-608 closed captions embedded in the video, including broadcast feeds that don't announce them
• Choose Off, Automatic (follows your Accessibility setting) or Always On, plus your preferred language
• Prefer closed captions over subtitles when a stream has both
• Captions are shown at the bottom center of the picture, or exactly where the broadcaster placed them
• Add your own WebVTT or SRT subtitle file to any channel
YOUR CHANNELS, EVERYWHERE
• Channels and settings sync through iCloud to every Apple TV and iPhone signed in with your Apple ID
• Add a channel on your iPhone and it's waiting on your Apple TV
DESIGNED FOR APPLE TV AND IPHONE
• Big, focus-friendly channel cards with ambient artwork and Continue Watching
• Use a channel's logo, or let the app create a poster from its name
• Test any stream before saving it to check it plays and see which subtitles and captions it carries
• Picture in Picture on iPhone
HLS Streaming plays streams you provide. It doesn't include any channels or content of its own; a few public test streams are included so you can try it right away.

flathub:io.github.lruzicka.Needly.description:
Needly is an openQA needle editor written in Python. It creates or modifies needles for openQA tests.
 The openQA needle consists of two files: a PNG screenshot and a JSON definition file. The definition
 file provides various information to the openQA engine, including tags, types, and areas to look for.
 Users can use this application to edit (or create) all the necessary information quickly and draw the
 areas using the built-in WYSIWYG editor. When the needle is saved, it is fully compatible with the
 openQA engine.
 The advantage of the editor is that it does not need openQA to be installed on the system. The needle
 files are all you need to work with them.
 Features:
 WYSIWYG needle editor
 Create and edit openQA test needles
 Screenshot handling
 Virtual machine screenshot capture via libvirt
 Support for multiple areas in a single needle

 Multiple file processing and folder support

Freeciv21 is a free open source turn-based empire-building 4x strategy game, in which each player becomes the leader of a civilization. Players strive to complete an empire that survives all encounters with its neighbors to emerge victorious. Play begins at the dawn of history in 4,000 BCE.

firefox-addons:3047059.name: pour - Accessibility Checker & WCAG Audit
firefox-addons:3047059.summary: One-click accessibility checker: WCAG 2.2 audits, contrast checks, exact fixes, and vision, sensory and motor filters.
firefox-addons:3047059.description:
pour is a complete accessibility checker for the pages you build and the pages you browse. One click runs a full WCAG 2.2 audit against the live page, with every finding tied to the exact element, a plain-language explanation, and a concrete fix.
WHAT IT CHECKS
99 original checks, written from the WCAG text itself, assist with the full range of success criteria: text alternatives, labels and names, colour contrast (including gradients, overlays and text over images), keyboard traps and focus visibility, target sizes, landmarks and structure, language, ARIA validity, moving content, and more. Cross-origin frames and open shadow DOM are audited too.
HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT KNOWS
pour reports a failure only when it can prove one. Anything that needs a person's judgement goes to a separate review list instead of being counted as a failure, so the number you see is one you can stand behind in a ticket or a report.
SEE WHAT YOUR USERS SEE
58 simulations and lenses let you experience the page as others do: colour-blindness in all its forms, tunnel vision, macular degeneration, cataracts, blur, low contrast and low light; sensory overload, visual stress and dyslexia-style reading effects; hand and resting tremor, pointer drift and keyboard-only browsing. Most show the share of people they stand for. All straight from the toolbar.
HEAR IT TOO
Play the page's own audio and video through hearing loss, tinnitus or a cochlear implant. Turning the volume up does not help; captions do. An age slider runs from twenty to ninety: the lens yellows, contrast and near focus fall, and from sixty-five the pointer shows a tremor.
FAST, AND MEASURED
Benchmarked on 138 live pages: a full audit of the typical page lands in tens of milliseconds, around three times faster than the engine most of the industry runs on. The heaviest page tested, at 194,000 DOM nodes, audits in seven seconds. Fast enough to re-run on every change without thinking about it.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything runs inside your browser. No page content, URL or audit result ever leaves your machine. No account, no tracking, no server. Audit intranets, local builds and pages behind a login.
FOR DEVELOPERS AND EVERYONE ELSE
Use the popup for a quick score, or open the DevTools panel for the full report while you work: highlight the element, jump to it in the inspector, and copy the report as Markdown, CSV or JSON. Designers, auditors, content editors and curious readers get the same one-click answer: is this page accessible, and if not, exactly what to fix.
FREE, WITH NO CATCH
pour is a non-profit initiative. No subscriptions, no paid tiers, no upsells. The engine is open source at github.com/pourdev/pour-engine . Learn more at pour.dev

firefox-addons:964372.name: Tabby - Window & Tab Manager
firefox-addons:964372.summary: Tabby helps you manage a lot of windows and tabs easily; it can help you open, close, move, pin, and do many other things on tabs and windows quickly. With Tabby, you can even save all you windows and tabs for later with just one click!
firefox-addons:964372.description:
Tabby is a Window and Tab Manager that helps you easily manage a lot of windows and tabs.
It can help you open, close, pin, and do many other things on tabs and windows quickly.
You can also drag around tabs to move it, open last used tab/window by using some simple keyboard shortcuts, and much more!
You can even save all you windows and tabs for later with just one click!
If you want to see more new features that have been added, go to the Release Notes section of this page.
Also, if you have some sweet ideas on how to improve Tabby, or if you found a bug in Tabby, go here to tell me about it:
 https://goo.gl/forms/hdEdjHo6RPwYCiJC2 
Keyboard shortcuts:
--- Open Tabby with focus on the search bar: Ctrl+Shift+Space
--- Open Tabby with focus on the current tab: Alt+Period
--- Open last used tab: Ctrl+Shift+L
--- Open last used window: Ctrl+Shift+0
When you are searching…
--- `Enter` to select the first result
When you have a tab selected…
--- ▲ and ▼ arrows to select the tab above and below the selected one
--- `Shift+S` while the search bar isn't focused to quickly navigate to the current tab in the Tabby list
--- `Enter` to go to the tab
--- `Delete` to close the tab
--- `M` to mute
--- `P` to pin
--- `S` to search
--- `F` to manually filter out any tabs that's not multiselected, or, if no tabs are multiselected, any tabs that are currently hidden, leaving you with just your selected or visible tabs
--- `D` to clear the manual filter
Multiselect with your mouse:
--- Select tabs: Cmd/Ctrl+<left click>
--- Select range: Shift+<left click>
--- Select all (visible) tabs within a window: Cmd/Ctrl+<clicking on a window>
--- Select all (visible): A
--- Invert (visible) selection: I
Layouts:
--- `Alt+Comma` to switch layouts between the default Popup, Window, Tab, and Sidebar layouts!
--- `Esc` to close Tabby -- Note: Works in every layout except Sidebar due to browser restrictions. For the Sidebar layout, use "Alt+Period" (or whatever the shortcut "Open Tabby with focus on the current tab" is set to use) instead to toggle visibility.
LAYOUT CAVEAT:
Due to browser restrictions, the Tabby popup icon in the title bar will open the standard popup no matter what layout is currently set as the default. This can be confusing, but there's a solution! The shortcut "Alt+Period" (or a custom shortcut of your choice) will always open the correct layout, so if you are willing to use that instead to open Tabby, you can always right click on the Tabby icon in the title bar and deselect "Pin to Toolbar" to reduce confusion.
Regex Search Syntax:
`re:/regex/flags` (example: `re:/github/is`)
Tabby uses fancy-regex, which is Rustlang-flavour Regex with Lookahead/Lookbehind added in, most regex features should be there.
Right click on a window to rename it!
Right clicking on tabs will also give you a context menu with several options:
--- Move Tab(s) to another window, or optionally a new one
--- Unload
--- Reload
Permissions Use:
"Access your data for all websites": To display a preview of a tab
"Access browser tabs": To manage tabs
"Store unlimited amount of client-side data": Save-for-later
"Access browser activity during navigation": Search indexing
Privacy:
All data used are either discarded when the browser is closed or, if saved (Save-for-Later), stored in the browser's built-in local storage or sync storage, depending on user choice.
As an open source addon, all builds are uploaded as is from the "releases" folder found on the GitHub repository.
Tabby will always be free and open-source! Check out it's GitHub page: https://github.com/Bill13579/tabby

firefox-addons:1555648.name: Mute Tab
firefox-addons:1555648.summary: Full control of noisy tabs with keyboard shortcut support
firefox-addons:1555648.description:
This browser extension provides control over muting, unmuting, and closing noisy tabs. When a tab is muted, it can still play video and audio streams silently, ensuring that unexpected noises from browser tabs, particularly ads and banners, don't interrupt your work. This feature is especially useful during meetings or online conferences. You can mute or unmute tabs with just one click. It uses a nonpersistent background script, which means it doesn't consume any resources unless actively used by the user.
Key Features:
1. Mute individual tabs
2. Mute other tabs in the current window
3. Mute tabs in other windows
4. Mute all tabs except the active one
5. Mute all incognito tabs
6. Monitor and mute newly opened tabs
7. Support dark mode (dark theme)
8. Focus Mode (stop muting the current tab and mute all others)
This extension allows you to toggle the muting state of the currently active tab, tabs in the current window, tabs in other windows, and all tabs except the active one. You can mute and unmute specific noisy tabs or enforce the muting state for all matching tabs. Additionally, you can close other noisy tabs using a single keyboard shortcut.
You can access the extension's controls either through the toolbar popup or by setting custom keyboard shortcuts, based on your preference. User-defined keyboard shortcuts provide access to all supported actions for muting and unmuting tabs.
Please note that this extension does not support custom rules for muting specific hostnames, as this functionality is already available in your browser and doesn't require duplication.
This project is open-source, and you can find the source code at https://github.com/balvin-perrie/mute-tab/ .

firefox-addons:1821467.name: Dark Theme for Yandex™
firefox-addons:1821467.summary: A highly customizable dark theme for Yandex homepage and search
firefox-addons:1821467.description:
This extension brings dark them (night mode) to Yandex homepage and Yandex search results. The extension is based on the inversion filter but offers custom user CSS code injection to fine-tune the theme to your needs. This extension also supports schedule on and off which allows the user to turn the dark them only during custom night time.
Note: If your browser has "allow access to search page results" option for extensions on the extensions manager, then you will need to accept it for the extension to be able to inject its CSS code.
Note: You can simply toggle the dark theme on and off from the toolbar button.

firefox-addons:3132686.name: Web Clipper for Super Productivity
firefox-addons:3132686.summary: Clip the current page, a link or selected text into Super Productivity as a task, with the page URL in the task notes. Needs the desktop app's local REST API turned on.
firefox-addons:3132686.description:
Web Clipper for Super Productivity saves the page you're on, a link, or any text you highlight as a task in your Super Productivity desktop app. The task gets the page title, the page URL in its notes, and optionally the text you selected. You can pick a project and tags before saving.
 How to use 
- Click the toolbar icon (or press Ctrl+Shift+Y), adjust the title, then click Add to Super Productivity.
- Select text first to use it as the task title, or keep it as a quote in the task notes.
- Or right-click a page, a link or selected text and choose the Super Productivity item in the menu.
 Setup 
1. In the Super Productivity desktop app, go to Settings -> Misc.
2. Enable the Local REST API and copy your Access Token.
3. Open this extension's options page, paste the token, click Save, then click Test connection.
4. If Firefox asks, allow access to 127.0.0.1 (about:addons -> this extension -> Permissions).
 Privacy 
The extension connects only to Super Productivity's local REST API on your own computer (127.0.0.1:3876). Your token stays in this browser's local extension storage. No external servers, analytics or tracking.
 Requirements 
The Super Productivity desktop app must be running on the same computer.
Free and open source. Source code: https://github.com/sravan-kb/super-productivity-browser-extension
